caption: The drawing shows a single western-style horse saddle positioned upright and facing slightly to the right, centered on a plain, off-white background. The saddle is predominantly rendered in shades of brown and tan, with intricate darker brown decorative tooling along the edges and main surfaces. The cantle is high and curves backward, and the seat is smoothly rounded. The saddle horn is prominent and curves forward. There is a silver or metallic-colored concho or plate on the left side near the horn. The stirrups are large, also brown, and hang down evenly from both sides, extending below the saddle. There are long, thin leather straps hanging at intervals from the saddle's skirt and stirrups. The drawing appears signed "Arthur E. Reynolds" just below and to the right of the saddle.
title: Saddle
